definitions.explanation: Describing or explaining something in detail. Also used as a suru verb meaning to describe in detail or to elaborate.

examples.japanese: {経緯|けいい}を{詳述|しょうじゅつ}した。
examples.english: I described the circumstances in detail.

examples.japanese: この{点|てん}については{後|のち}ほど{詳述|しょうじゅつ}する。
examples.english: I will elaborate on this point later.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}には{調査|ちょうさ}{結果|けっか}が{詳述|しょうじゅつ}されている。
examples.english: The survey results are described in detail in the report.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {詳|しょう} (detailed) + {述|じゅつ} (to state). Primarily used in formal writing — reports, academic papers, and official documents. Typically used as a suru verb ({詳述|しょうじゅつ}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詳述|しょうじゅつ}する (to describe in detail)
- {以下|いか}に{詳述|しょうじゅつ}する (to elaborate below)
- {詳述|しょうじゅつ}は{省|はぶ}く (to omit detailed explanation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {詳細|しょうさい}に{述|の}べる: to describe in detail — a more everyday phrasing
- {略述|りゃくじゅつ}: brief description — the opposite, summarizing briefly
